items.question: How long does the audit take?
items.answer: We deliver your personalized audit report within 48 hours of receiving your information. The report itself takes about 30 minutes to review.

items.question: Is this really free?
items.answer: Yes. No credit card, no commitment. We do this because most brands don't realize how much revenue their content is leaving on the table. When they see the data, many choose to work with us.

items.question: What ecommerce platforms do you work with?
items.answer: Shopify, Magento, BigCommerce, WooCommerce, and custom builds. If you sell online, we can audit your content.

items.question: Do I need HubSpot?
items.answer: No. The audit works regardless of your marketing stack. If you do use HubSpot, we can go deeper on attribution data.
